name: DLMC live-reserve sell pricing
summary: DLMCToken priced buys and sells from its live USDT reserve, so linked buys could transiently raise the price used by a subsequent sell and remove more USDT than the buys supplied.

loss.notes: DLMCToken receives exactly 420,000 + 1,000,000 = 1,420,000 USDT and sends 1,646,119.118936329868440038 USDT in the sole campaign receipt, for gross victim depletion of 226,119.118936329868440038 USDT. Its archive USDT balance falls from 226,119.118936329868440044 to 0.000000000000000006, exactly the same net change; no unrelated same-block adjustment is required. Of the depleted amount, 3,558.897243107769423559 USDT repays financing and 222,560.221693222099016479 USDT reaches the profit receiver. The seed measured only the latter proceeds. DLMC minted or transferred in exchange for the two buys is consideration, not an additional victim asset. Later movement of proceeds or recovery is outside this exploit-time gross-loss boundary.

ageReset.description: DLMCToken is a direct contract. Its runtime was absent in the preceding block and is byte-identical at deployment and immediately before the incident.

sources.note: Reviewed the incident receipt and call trace, every USDT transfer touching DLMCToken and the financing pair, archive balances at block 106,091,606 and 106,091,607, the nested constructor scope, DLMCToken's creation receipt and historical runtime, and its proxy slots. The sender's nonce 0 transaction top-level creates coordinator 0x4adbddea5781caccadd9f73f00e07201b541414e, which creates 0xe81bf6e392eca9ad594b5452ea53cf7071760a04, which creates buy helper 0x8b5a72c4ce0d3a7676ce06b8e42aeb255bba476e. Those contracts call registerAffiliate, buy, buy and sell directly on DLMCToken; the sender and all three helpers end the receipt with zero USDT. DLMCToken receives 1,420,000 USDT and sends 1,646,119.118936329868440038. The financing pair starts with 16,532,817.320133703585971932 USDT and ends with 16,536,376.217376811355395491, a 3,558.897243107769423559 gain; the profit receiver starts at zero and receives 222,560.221693222099016479. DLMCToken was top-level created by 0xdd1970a587246185989fbbad48f6ba449b792b54 in source-2 at block 94,985,601 index 2, timestamp 1,777,295,932. Its 24,563-byte runtime is absent one block earlier and hashes to 0xb47348351b5e80c667270f22e8379ebb79771a767e997e439a68ad3433a35df9 at creation and immediately before the incident; EIP-1967 implementation and beacon slots are zero. The constructor helper is campaign machinery and is not the aged artifact.
